question: When was the first crewed Moon landing, and what spacecraft carried the astronauts?
initial_answer: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon in 1969. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the Moon.

evidence.text: Apollo 11 was the first crewed mission to land on the Moon. It landed on July 20, 1969. Astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the lunar surface.
The Apollo 11 crew included Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins.
